<a id="dataviz"></a>
### Dataviz (chart system)

`dataviz` · skill · **core** · phases: Design, Build

Method for charts, stat tiles and dashboards that read as one system: form heuristic, color formula, mark specs, interaction rules.

**Use when**
- Before writing ANY chart, KPI tile, sparkline or legend

**How to use**
- Pick the chart from the question; one categorical palette; same look in light and dark

**Pairs with:** [Data Visualization (Python)](dataviz.md#data-visualization) · [Build Dashboard (HTML report)](dataviz.md#build-dashboard)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/04-data-viz.md](../../docs/design/04-data-viz.md)

<a id="build-dashboard"></a>
### Build Dashboard (HTML report)

`data:build-dashboard` · skill · **recommended** · phases: Design, Build

Builds interactive self-contained HTML dashboards with KPI cards, charts, filters and tables.

**Use when**
- A one-off reporting dashboard or a prototype of the analytics view

**Avoid when**
- The CRM app itself (use the Next.js stack)

**How to use**
- Borrow its KPI-card and filter layouts for the app's analytics page

**Pairs with:** [Dataviz (chart system)](dataviz.md#dataviz)
